activity.notes: ATLAS uses 645 as Xuanzang's representative Tang activity year: after departing Chang'an in 629 for his pilgrimage to India, he returned to Tang China in 645 with Buddhist texts and relics. This single-year Activity represents the culmination of the pilgrimage and the beginning of his major translation work under Tang patronage.

sources.title: Central and North Asia, 500–1000 A.D. — The Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum of Art chronology records Xuanzang's pilgrimage across Central Asia and India from 629 to 645 and places it in the Tang-period context.
